email.subject1: a signal play for Energy Exemplar
email.body1:
Tyler, saw Energy Exemplar is pushing hard on international expansion, new EMEA and India leadership and the Xcelerate 2026 conference.

Expanding into new regions usually means more in-market accounts than the team can route and act on before signals go stale. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Energy Exemplar off your hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing those signals tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tyler, quick follow-up for Energy Exemplar.

Running global RevOps, the drag is latency: signals fire across regions and time zones, but nobody touches them fast enough, so qualified pipeline decays in the queue. That gap usually surfaces late, after a quarter is at risk.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, and our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Tyler, last bit of proof for Energy Exemplar.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Energy Exemplar's reply rate likely compares to similar enterprise software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tyler, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a RevOps priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up new regions is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your global motion? I'll tailor it to Energy Exemplar either way.
